statements.name: Spec
statements.says: The hook starts idle and follows the bounded call, callback and cleanup steps.

statements.name: LatestOutcomeOnly
statements.says: Every applied outcome belongs to the current compile, and a worker message must also carry that compile's job id.

statements.name: ExactlyOnce
statements.says: A compile applies at most one terminal outcome.

statements.name: WorkerExclusivity
statements.says: At most one worker is live at any instant, including inside a compile call.

statements.name: StoppedWorkersGone
statements.says: No worker remains live when the status is not compiling or the hook is unmounted.

statements.name: TimersCleared
statements.says: Completed compiles have no registered timer, and no timer remains when compiling stops or the hook unmounts.

statements.name: CancelIsIdle
statements.says: After a cancel and until another compile starts, the hook stays idle with no failure.

statements.name: ResourceOwnership
statements.says: Every live worker and registered timer belongs to the current compile and agrees with the hook's refs.

statements.name: PendingCompileIsClean
statements.says: A current unfinished compile in a mounted hook has compiling status and no failure.

statements.name: OutcomeStateCorrect
statements.says: A completed current compile has its terminal status and its own source-tagged result or failure.

statements.name: ResultProvenance
statements.says: Any retained result comes from the most recently applied successful compile.

statements.name: FailureCleared
statements.says: Idle, compiling and successful states have no failure.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: All hook state, observed resources, job tokens and callback records stay within their declared types and bounds.

statements.name: CanCompile
statements.says: The hook can start a compile.

statements.name: CanFinishDone
statements.says: The current compile can finish successfully.

statements.name: CanFailCompile
statements.says: The current compile can report a compile failure.

statements.name: CanFailEnvironment
statements.says: The current compile can report an environment or worker failure.

statements.name: CanTimeOut
statements.says: The current compile can time out.

statements.name: CanCancel
statements.says: Cancelling can leave the hook idle.

statements.name: CanReplacePending
statements.says: A second compile can replace an unfinished first compile and finish successfully.

statements.name: CanRetainResultWhileCompiling
statements.says: The last successful result can remain visible while a newer compile runs.

statements.name: CanRetainResultAfterCancel
statements.says: The last successful result can remain visible after cancellation.

statements.name: CanUnmountCleanly
statements.says: Effect cleanup can leave an unmounted hook with no worker or timer.

statements.name: EveryUnreplacedCompileEnds
statements.says: A compile that remains current while the hook remains mounted eventually applies a terminal outcome.

statements.name: CallbackDispatchProgress
statements.says: The event loop eventually processes a continuously enabled terminal callback for the current compile.

statements.name: BugStaleResult

statements.name: BugStaleFailure

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE LatestCompile ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxCompiles, MaxCancels, MaxTimeouts

VARIABLES issued, jobId, cancelCount, timeoutCount, mounted,
          status, result, failure, workerRef, timeoutRef,
          liveWorkers, timers, peakWorkers, applications

vars == <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, timeoutCount, mounted,
          status, result, failure, workerRef, timeoutRef,
          liveWorkers, timers, peakWorkers, applications>>

\* One transition is a public call, callback, or effect cleanup, followed
\* by React's settled state. Job numbers are the actual jobIdRef tokens;
\* cancel increments that ref even when there is no active worker.
\* A result/failure source is represented by the token of the compile
\* whose captured source produced it. Payload bytes and diagnostic text
\* are outside these lifecycle rules.
\*
\* liveWorkers and timers come from the driver's Worker/timer registries.
\* peakWorkers is the maximum live count observed INSIDE calls, including
\* at each Worker construction, so atomic calls cannot hide an overlap.
\* applications is an observation log of terminal state-setting batches:
\* callback owner, jobIdRef at invocation, message job id (or callback
\* owner for onerror/timer), and outcome. It records actual setter calls,
\* including repeated writes, rather than inferring them from final values.
\*
\* Ordinary current-job events require a live worker or registered timer.
\* Termination and clearTimeout prevent further ordinary delivery.
\* Saved callbacks from replaced jobs are additionally invoked adversarially
\* to check the explicit generation guards. Their timeout invocations count
\* toward the single timeout-event budget even when ignored.
\* Constructor/postMessage exceptions and calls after unmount are outside
\* this worker-callback lifecycle. Unmount runs the supplied effect cleanup
\* without changing status, result, failure, or jobIdRef.

Jobs == 1..(MaxCompiles + MaxCancels)

OutcomeKinds == {"done", "compile", "environment", "timeout"}

Statuses == {"idle", "compiling", "done", "error", "timeout"}

NoFailure == [source |-> 0, kind |-> "none"]

ApplicationType ==
    [job : Jobs, generation : 0..(MaxCompiles + MaxCancels),
     response : Jobs, kind : OutcomeKinds]

Completed(j) ==
    \E i \in 1..Len(applications) : applications[i].job = j

CompletedJobs ==
    {applications[i].job : i \in 1..Len(applications)}

OutcomeStatus(k) ==
    IF k = "done" THEN "done"
    ELSE IF k = "timeout" THEN "timeout" ELSE "error"

SuccessIndices ==
    {i \in 1..Len(applications) : applications[i].kind = "done"}

LastSuccess ==
    IF SuccessIndices = {} THEN 0
    ELSE applications[
        CHOOSE i \in SuccessIndices : \A n \in SuccessIndices : n <= i
    ].job

LatestOutcomeOnly ==
    \A i \in 1..Len(applications) :
        /\ applications[i].job = applications[i].generation
        /\ applications[i].response = applications[i].job

ExactlyOnce ==
    \A j \in issued :
        Cardinality({i \in 1..Len(applications) :
            applications[i].job = j}) <= 1

WorkerExclusivity ==
    /\ peakWorkers <= 1
    /\ Cardinality(liveWorkers) <= 1

StoppedWorkersGone ==
    (status # "compiling" \/ ~mounted) => liveWorkers = {}

TimersCleared ==
    /\ CompletedJobs \cap timers = {}
    /\ (status # "compiling" \/ ~mounted) =>
        (timers = {} /\ timeoutRef = 0)

CancelIsIdle ==
    jobId \notin issued => (status = "idle" /\ failure = NoFailure)

ResourceOwnership ==
    /\ liveWorkers \cup timers \subseteq
        (IF mounted /\ status = "compiling" THEN {jobId} ELSE {})
    /\ liveWorkers = (IF workerRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {workerRef})
    /\ timers = (IF timeoutRef = 0 THEN {} ELSE {timeoutRef})

PendingCompileIsClean ==
    (mounted /\ jobId \in issued /\ ~Completed(jobId)) =>
        (status = "compiling" /\ failure = NoFailure)

OutcomeStateCorrect ==
    \A i \in 1..Len(applications) :
        LET a == applications[i] IN
        a.job = jobId =>
            /\ status = OutcomeStatus(a.kind)
            /\ IF a.kind = "done"
                THEN result = a.job /\ failure = NoFailure
                ELSE failure = [source |-> a.job, kind |-> a.kind]

ResultProvenance ==
    result = 0 \/ result = LastSuccess

FailureCleared ==
    status \in {"idle", "compiling", "done"} => failure = NoFailure

TypeOK ==
    /\ issued \subseteq Jobs
    /\ Cardinality(issued) <= MaxCompiles
    /\ jobId \in 0..(MaxCompiles + MaxCancels)
    /\ cancelCount \in 0..MaxCancels
    /\ timeoutCount \in 0..MaxTimeouts
    /\ mounted \in BOOLEAN
    /\ status \in Statuses
    /\ result \in Jobs \cup {0}
    /\ failure \in [source : Jobs \cup {0}, kind : OutcomeKinds \cup {"none"}]
    /\ workerRef \in Jobs \cup {0}
    /\ timeoutRef \in Jobs \cup {0}
    /\ liveWorkers \subseteq issued
    /\ timers \subseteq issued
    /\ peakWorkers \in 0..MaxCompiles
    /\ applications \in Seq(ApplicationType)
    /\ Len(applications) <= MaxCompiles + 1

CanCompile == mounted /\ status = "compiling"

CanFinishDone == status = "done"

CanFailCompile == status = "error" /\ failure.kind = "compile"

CanFailEnvironment == status = "error" /\ failure.kind = "environment"

CanTimeOut == status = "timeout"

CanCancel == jobId > 0 /\ jobId \notin issued /\ status = "idle"

CanReplacePending ==
    /\ Cardinality(issued) = MaxCompiles
    /\ status = "done"
    /\ \E j \in issued : j < jobId /\ ~Completed(j)

CanRetainResultWhileCompiling ==
    status = "compiling" /\ result # 0 /\ result # jobId

CanRetainResultAfterCancel ==
    jobId \notin issued /\ status = "idle" /\ result # 0

CanUnmountCleanly ==
    ~mounted /\ liveWorkers = {} /\ timers = {}

EveryUnreplacedCompileEnds ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (mounted /\ j \in issued /\ j = jobId)
            ~> (~mounted \/ j < jobId \/ Completed(j))

Init ==
    /\ issued = {}
    /\ jobId = 0
    /\ cancelCount = 0
    /\ timeoutCount = 0
    /\ mounted = TRUE
    /\ status = "idle"
    /\ result = 0
    /\ failure = NoFailure
    /\ workerRef = 0
    /\ timeoutRef = 0
    /\ liveWorkers = {}
    /\ timers = {}
    /\ peakWorkers = 0
    /\ applications = <<>>

StartCompile ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ Cardinality(issued) < MaxCompiles
    /\ issued' = issued \cup {jobId + 1}
    /\ jobId' = jobId + 1
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failure' = NoFailure
    /\ workerRef' = jobId + 1
    /\ timeoutRef' = jobId + 1
    /\ liveWorkers' = {jobId + 1}
    /\ timers' = {jobId + 1}
    /\ peakWorkers' = 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cancelCount, timeoutCount, mounted, result, applications>>

Cancel ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ cancelCount < MaxCancels
    /\ jobId' = jobId + 1
    /\ cancelCount' = cancelCount + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failure' = NoFailure
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timers' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, timeoutCount, mounted, result, peakWorkers, applications>>

\* The driver's event loop delivers one terminal callback: a matching
\* worker message (done/compile/environment), onerror (environment), or
\* the registered timer (timeout). Message and onerror environment failures
\* have the same projection. No fairness selects a particular outcome.
DispatchCurrent ==
    \E k \in OutcomeKinds :
        /\ mounted
        /\ status = "compiling"
        /\ workerRef = jobId
        /\ timeoutRef = jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN jobId ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> jobId, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> jobId, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> jobId, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

IgnoreStaleMessage ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ \E j \in issued : j < jobId
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

IgnoreStaleWorkerError ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ \E j \in issued : j < jobId
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

IgnoreStaleTimeout ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ \E j \in issued : j < jobId
    /\ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts
    /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, status, result,
        failure, workerRef, timeoutRef, liveWorkers, timers,
        peakWorkers, applications>>

IgnoreWrongResponseId ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ workerRef # 0
    /\ \E response \in Jobs : response # workerRef
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Unmount ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ mounted' = FALSE
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timers' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, timeoutCount, status,
        result, failure, peakWorkers, applications>>

Rest ==
    /\ (status # "compiling" \/ ~mounted)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartCompile
    \/ Cancel
    \/ DispatchCurrent
    \/ IgnoreStaleMessage
    \/ IgnoreStaleWorkerError
    \/ IgnoreStaleTimeout
    \/ IgnoreWrongResponseId
    \/ Unmount
    \/ Rest

CallbackDispatchProgress == WF_vars(DispatchCurrent)

\* Known-bug actions are deliberately excluded from Next.
BugStaleResult ==
    \E j \in issued, k \in {"done"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ j < jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> j, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> j, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> j, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugStaleFailure ==
    \E j \in issued, k \in {"compile", "environment"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ j < jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> j, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> j, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> j, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugStaleTimeout ==
    \E j \in issued, k \in {"timeout"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ j < jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN j ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> j, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> j, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> j, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugWrongResponseId ==
    \E k \in {"done"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ status = "compiling"
        /\ workerRef = jobId
        /\ timeoutRef = jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN jobId ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> jobId, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> jobId, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> (IF jobId = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1), kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugDoubleCompletion ==
    \E k \in {"done"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ jobId \in issued
        /\ Completed(jobId)
        /\ Len(applications) < MaxCompiles + 1
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN jobId ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> jobId, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> jobId, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> jobId, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugSpawnBeforeTerminate ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ Cardinality(issued) < MaxCompiles
    /\ issued' = issued \cup {jobId + 1}
    /\ jobId' = jobId + 1
    /\ status' = "compiling"
    /\ failure' = NoFailure
    /\ workerRef' = jobId + 1
    /\ timeoutRef' = jobId + 1
    /\ liveWorkers' = {jobId + 1}
    /\ timers' = {jobId + 1}
    /\ peakWorkers' = Cardinality(liveWorkers) + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cancelCount, timeoutCount, mounted, result, applications>>

BugCancelLeaksWorker ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ cancelCount < MaxCancels
    /\ jobId' = jobId + 1
    /\ cancelCount' = cancelCount + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failure' = NoFailure
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = liveWorkers
    /\ timers' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, timeoutCount, mounted, result, peakWorkers, applications>>

BugTimeoutLeaksWorker ==
    \E k \in {"timeout"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ status = "compiling"
        /\ workerRef = jobId
        /\ timeoutRef = jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN jobId ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> jobId, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = liveWorkers
        /\ timers' = {}
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> jobId, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> jobId, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugCompletionLeaksTimer ==
    \E k \in {"done"} :
        /\ mounted
        /\ status = "compiling"
        /\ workerRef = jobId
        /\ timeoutRef = jobId
        /\ (k # "timeout" \/ timeoutCount < MaxTimeouts)
        /\ timeoutCount' = timeoutCount + (IF k = "timeout" THEN 1 ELSE 0)
        /\ status' = OutcomeStatus(k)
        /\ result' = IF k = "done" THEN jobId ELSE result
        /\ failure' = IF k = "done" THEN failure
            ELSE [source |-> jobId, kind |-> k]
        /\ workerRef' = 0
        /\ timeoutRef' = 0
        /\ liveWorkers' = {}
        /\ timers' = timers
        /\ applications' = Append(applications,
            [job |-> jobId, generation |-> jobId,
             response |-> jobId, kind |-> k])
        /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, jobId, cancelCount, mounted, peakWorkers>>

BugCancelKeepsFailure ==
    /\ mounted
    /\ cancelCount < MaxCancels
    /\ jobId' = jobId + 1
    /\ cancelCount' = cancelCount + 1
    /\ status' = "idle"
    /\ failure' = failure
    /\ workerRef' = 0
    /\ timeoutRef' = 0
    /\ liveWorkers' = {}
    /\ timers' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<issued, timeoutCount, mounted, result, peakWorkers, applications>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

rules.name: Spec
rules.says: The hook starts idle and follows the bounded call, callback and cleanup steps.

rules.name: LatestOutcomeOnly
rules.says: Every applied outcome belongs to the current compile, and a worker message must also carry that compile's job id.

rules.name: ExactlyOnce
rules.says: A compile applies at most one terminal outcome.

rules.name: WorkerExclusivity
rules.says: At most one worker is live at any instant, including inside a compile call.

rules.name: StoppedWorkersGone
rules.says: No worker remains live when the status is not compiling or the hook is unmounted.

rules.name: TimersCleared
rules.says: Completed compiles have no registered timer, and no timer remains when compiling stops or the hook unmounts.

rules.name: CancelIsIdle
rules.says: After a cancel and until another compile starts, the hook stays idle with no failure.

rules.name: ResourceOwnership
rules.says: Every live worker and registered timer belongs to the current compile and agrees with the hook's refs.

rules.name: PendingCompileIsClean
rules.says: A current unfinished compile in a mounted hook has compiling status and no failure.

rules.name: OutcomeStateCorrect
rules.says: A completed current compile has its terminal status and its own source-tagged result or failure.

rules.name: ResultProvenance
rules.says: Any retained result comes from the most recently applied successful compile.

rules.name: FailureCleared
rules.says: Idle, compiling and successful states have no failure.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: All hook state, observed resources, job tokens and callback records stay within their declared types and bounds.
